summary: Tested Phase-2 product discovery/navigation on preview for backend + frontend. Core discovery flows, finder 4-step category query application, canonical persistence, mobile filter sheet/overflow, desktop mega-menu structure, static prerendered /products HTML checks, and SEO regression status were verified. Two issues found: product compare CTA misroutes to product detail, and catalogue/API data has no refresh_rate surfaced for decision cards.

critical.issue: No returned products expose refresh_rate (0/200), so decision-ready card data cannot include refresh rate as requested.

ui_bugs.issue: Compare CTA ([data-testid^='products-compare-']) navigates to product detail page instead of /compare.

integration_issues.issue: Compare href attribute is '/compare' but click routing resolves to '/products/{slug}', indicating click interception/overlap in card layout.

action_items: Fix product card CTA layering/interaction so Compare always routes to /compare.
Expose/normalize refresh_rate in product catalogue API data where available (or align requirement/UI copy if intentionally unavailable).
Re-run product discovery regression on /products desktop + mobile after CTA fix.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductCard likely has click-target overlap: compare link intent differs from resulting navigation, suggesting a higher z-index/overlay or anchor-region conflict.
Decision field parity gap: frontend expects refresh_rate conditionally but backend catalogue currently provides none, creating a feature-requirement mismatch.

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core discovery/navigation checks pass; compare CTA fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://app-router-parity.preview.emergentagent.com/products. PASS: /products loads without page error text; discovery tabs work; finder completes 4 steps and applies category via query only; canonical remains https://brightluxx.com/products after query updates; mobile 390x844 filter bottom-sheet opens and category applies with no horizontal overflow; desktop products mega-menu has By Product/Application/Technology + direct links (all products/finder/compare/architects); static build/products/index.html has one H1, canonical /products, internal links; seo-regression-report.json shows PASS with failCount=0. FAIL: compare CTA routes to product detail. Search terms P1.2/COB/video wall/meeting room/transparent display/digital totem return nonzero API/UI results when tested without active category filter.
rca of the issue: Compare CTA failure RCA: Compare anchor has href '/compare' but runtime click navigates to '/products/{slug}'. Reproduced consistently on first product card. Most likely cause is card-level click-target overlap/interception from adjacent product detail link/overlay region in ProductCard layout. Refresh-rate gap RCA: catalogue payload currently lacks refresh_rate across products, so UI cannot render this decision field despite requirement coverage.
